author: Kenneth Grahame
title: The Wind in the Willows
edition: New York: Charles Scribner’s Sons, October 1913, explicitly dated MCMXIII and Published October 1913 in Project Gutenberg 27805. Prose line-wrap whitespace is collapsed; paragraph boundaries and original punctuation are retained. Illustration captions are omitted; embedded verse preserves lines and stanzas. The library text holds all twelve chapters; chapter numerals are joined with their titles as headings, song titles keep the transcription’s indentation, and the star dividers between sections are kept.

rights.basis: The original English text in this 1913 edition was published before 1931 and is public domain in the United States in 2026. The dated source and its public-domain record are linked; no modern introductions, annotations, or illustrations are reproduced.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (eBook 27805, UTF-8, CRLF normalised to LF) from the PG mirror (the same eBook as the textUrl). Kept Chapters I–XII; removed the PG header and footer, title and copyright pages, contents, list of illustrations, [Illustration] captions, and the closing repeated title. Blank-line separated paragraphs were joined with single spaces at line ends, keeping spacing inside lines and the transcription’s _underscore_ italics and -- dashes; every indented chunk (the songs, the doorplate, Toad’s programme) is a stanza with the transcription’s lines and indentation kept and only trailing spaces removed; the indented song titles (DUCKS’ DITTY, CAROL, TOAD’S LAST LITTLE SONG) are headings kept exactly as indented in the transcription, as the nightly readings keep them; the star dividers between sections stay as one-line paragraphs; chapter numerals are joined with their titles as headings. Converted by a scratch Node script; every nightly reading was located exactly.
